counting: xml_nodes counts root/element/text/comment nodes in lexical order, including whitespace text; excludes declaration, attribute names/values. depth increments only nested child element, text/comment inherit containing element depth. Attribute count checked independently per element before values. Each decoded attribute/text/comment string checked individually; XML attributes remain strings, no JSON number-token rule.
error_shape: CodecError::ResourceLimit {path:XML path,token:input_bytes|depth|xml_nodes|string_bytes|attributes}; input_bytes path=/; child element pointers use /tag[index] 1-based among same-tag siblings; text/comment use /text()[index] or /comment()[index]; attribute uses /@name. No truncated path equality assertions.
precedence: strict UTF8/no BOM per proposed encoding profile
token grammar; actual DOCTYPE/namespace/general entity/PI feature reject before expansion or full AST allocation
on start-element: depth -> xml_nodes -> attributes count -> decoded attribute strings in source order
on text/comment: xml_nodes -> decoded string bytes
after guarded full parse: format/version/required unique sections
only after representation validation: semantic projection, trusted dependency validation, owner install
security: DTD/external/general entities and namespace/PI unsupported profile. Detect tokens using lexer context, never substring-scan comments/text. A comment containing literal <!DOCTYPE is inert text if otherwise legal. No network/filesystem callbacks in codec.
fixture_policy: Resource recipes must expand exact input and verify counts before product call; wrong recipe or unavailable dependency is fixture failure, never valid RED. Unknown extra payload element is preserved/unsupported view per unapproved R2 profile, not silently discarded.
